content:
Alisa: Dropped a new mock for the credentials page focused on rotate/revoke flows. Trying a less modal-heavy approach: inline revoke -> lightweight confirm toast + undo. Figma: https://figma.com/file/newflow
Jon: Inline revoke is nice but accidental clicks worry me. Can you add a small lock icon and require caret+click to reveal the destructive action?
Priya: Accessibility: if we use a toast undo, ensure screen readers announce both the revoke and the undo option. Use aria-live and keyboard focusable undo button.
Dinesh: Backend check: is undo supported? @ui-bot can you confirm flag and endpoint state?
ui-bot: Feature flag `key_revoke_undo` = false in staging. Backend route POST /keys/{id}/undo exists but is rate-limited and gated by flag.
Alisa: Ok will gate undo copy behind the flag. If flag off, modal copy will say "This action cannot be undone." If on, we include "Undo available for 30s."
Jon: Also microcopy: replace generic "Rotate key" with "Rotate key (issue new credential and revoke old)" to clarify that rotation issues a new secret. Users kept thinking rotate edits the same token.
Priya: Empty state suggestion: title "No API keys yet", body "Create an API key to call Redwood Inference. Use scoped permissions to restrict access.", primary CTA "Create API key", secondary link "Best practices for scopes". Keep it centered for the compact table view.
Dinesh: Audit data: don't hide created/last-used columns completely. Collapse them into a details drawer accessible by keyboard (Enter/Space) so auditors can still export timestamps.
Alisa: UX plan: 1) Show rotated copy update, 2) conditional revoke language, 3) move destructive CTA into a kebab menu with confirm flow, 4) details drawer for timestamps, 5) add a11y checklist to the PR template. I'll push an updated figma in ~90m.
Jon: Add PR checklist items: keyboard nav, 44px touch targets, ARIA on toasts/modals, color contrast for permission chips. Put links to axe test results in PR.
Priya: One more: ensure focus is returned to a logical element after confirm/undo (e.g., the row or first action) and announce final status via aria-live.
Alisa: Thanks, team. I'll iterate and ping when ready for review. :rocket:
